verdicts.reason: A: the ULTRA logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck in the middle of the step text, step 03 is stranded at the top right next to the CTA, steps 01/02 are illegibly tiny, and the legal copy is nearly as big as the subhead. B shares those last two faults: the step text is microscopic and the legal block competes with the headline. It also puts a tiny '03' ahead of 01 at the top left, so the steps read out of order. Even so, B keeps a legible ULTRA logo and keeps all three steps together in one block, which makes it the less broken resize.
